No. Of the 81.3 hectares of mapped 2021 tree-cover loss, 68.1 hectares (about 84%) overlapped mapped pine plantation, while 13.2 hectares lay outside mapped forest. None overlapped mapped native forest.

The map does not establish what vegetation was present outside mapped forest or what caused the loss. A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches under 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event; its location relative to the plantation is not provided.
